verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Bitwarden's Public API gives organizations tools for managing policies, which implies a first-party org policy capability. Nothing documents which policies exist or how they are enforced on members' apps. Missing for 10: documented app-lock/vault-timeout policy, documented vault-export restriction policy, documented master-password strength requirement policy, evidence of enforcement across every member's client, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app

citations.quote: The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
